Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency and rollout controls. We're starting our vendor security review and would like to run through your completed CAIQ and SIG responses together to confirm a handful of control artifacts.

Would you have 30 minutes this week for a quick sync? Primary asks:
- Walk through CAIQ answers where we flagged controls (network segmentation, key management).
- Confirm list of evidentiary artifacts we should expect (SOC 2, configuration screenshots, SCIM logs).
- Establish an owner and ETA for each item.

Attached is our CAIQ with the highlighted questions. Proposed times (PST): Mon 02/02 10:00, Tue 02/03 14:00, Wed 02/04 11:30 — please let me know what works and who from your side will join.

Thanks,

Laura / Samantha / Marcus —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick pre-call note and checklist so our 30m is productive:

1) Who owns which artifacts (proposed):
   - SOC 2 report (redacted): Security Ops (Mina) — ETA 5 business days
   - Key management diagram + KMS configuration screenshots: Infra (I will pull) — ETA 3 business days
   - Network segmentation diagram / VPC config: Infra — ETA 3 business days
   - Access control lists (sample) & SCIM provisioning logs: Engineering Ops (shared) — ETA 4 business days

2) Questions I want to address on the call:
   - CAIQ Q1.2/3: physical access / on-prem components — confirm we do not host customer data on-prem by default
   - SIG: cryptographic key rotation frequency and proof of rotation
   - Logging/retention: what logs are available via Console and what we can export to customer SIEM

3) Artifacts I'll attach after the call: redacted SOC2, kms-config-2026-02.png, scim-sample-log.txt

4) Agenda suggestion for 30m:
   - 0-5m: introduc tions and scope
   - 5-15m: walk flagged CAIQ/SIG items (Samantha + Mina)
   - 15-25m: agree owners & ETAs
   - 25-30m: confirm next steps / point of contact for artifact upload

I'll review the BlueHarbor CAIQ ahead of the call and update our draft answers. Marcus, can you please confirm whether procurement will need a contractor NDA or a standard SOW?

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
